_readme: Hand-curated highlights merged into the auto-fetched Google Scholar list. Key each entry by arXiv ID (or the exact paper title). Fields: venue (replaces 'Preprint'), tags, awards, note, code, slides. Papers not listed here still appear automatically.

2507.10325.note: Introduces client availability into the federated learning paradigm and proves convergence of agnostic FedAvg at rate O(1/√T).

2509.14444.note: Transport-based aggregation that aligns availability and importance distributions via masked OT and Sinkhorn scaling, with convergence guarantees in nonsmooth convex settings and strong gains in low-availability regimes.

2512.17878.note: Where optimal transport meets information geometry: a weighted SDE that implements Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao gradient flow for faster sampling.

2509.25334.note: Entropy-guided weighting and sampling for CVAE oversampling (LEO-CVAE), improving on SMOTE-style and generative baselines on ADNI and TCGA lung cancer data.
